notes.title: Big Anniversary Update
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39742432/4eb7a3efce2b2e347939047a898fad05fa51adca.png[/img]

Almost two years after the release of the game, I decided to rethink it. First of all, I fixed a bunch of old bugs. And started writing a new story. More precisely, the plot is not entirely new, rather expanded. The original version of the game asked a lot of questions, but did not give answers to them, which is why players had to think out the plot on their own.

After spending a whole year without access to a computer and the Internet, I thought a lot. Mostly I was thinking about my future projects. However, the Concealment did not let me go. I've been thinking a lot about how to improve the game so that both old players and new ones like it.

[b]Changes and improvements:[/b]
[list]
[*] Improved and expanded plot.
[*] New scenes and locations.
[*] New music and sounds.
[*] Now there are 3 endings in the game, one of which is secret.
[*] Fixed old bugs.
[*] Added new puzzles.
[*] And much more.
[/list]

notes.title: Bug fix
notes.content: Fixed a text disappearing bug that could cause the game to crash.

notes.title: Bug fixes.
notes.content: Some minor bugs have been fixed. The font size has been increased. After the death of the player, the level is reset.

notes.title: Concealment is now available!
notes.content:
I would like to thank all those who added the game to the wishlist. I was very pleased to see that someone was interested in my game. Now, after about a month of waiting, you can finally play Concealment.
This is my first game that was completed to the end. A huge thank you to everyone who was waiting for its release. Have a nice game.
